g.text: awsplace GitLab CI: four stages, and the RaftDB image chain of custody
self-hosted GitLab at git.namanhishere.com . every line reference is .gitlab-ci.yml . grey = ordinary stage flow, orange = custody chain
CHAIN OF CUSTODY . the tested bytes are the deployed bytes
raftdb-image can build, run and scan the image without ever
holding an AWS credential, so a compromised build step has
nothing to push with. publish-raftdb-image proves, byte for
byte, that the artifact it received is the artifact that was
tested, and only then asks STS for a 3600 s session.
deploy-to-aws re-proves the digest before it authenticates.
